essence: Therefore the lakṣmī-seed mantra grants complete sovereignty.
Therefore this ṣoḍaśī-mantra consists of seventeen syllables.
Therefore the lajjā-enveloped mantra has the supreme power to attract the three worlds.
Therefore the speech-seed-enveloped mantra grants mastery over speech.
Therefore this great-mantra perpetually grants both enjoyment and liberation.
